notes: Test selection for the Quality Automation Testing page (scripts/qa-testing-page.mjs) and scripts/run-suite-queue.mjs: pick families (or a preset suite) and games/packages. Each package runs through the worker monitor, max 4 games at a time. gameIds must match config/manifests/*.json. Saved selections live in config/qa-selections/.
familyNotes: One entry per tests/specs/<folder>, in display order. group places the family on the QA page: regression families make up 'All Regression'; security (PEN) runs only when named explicitly; other families are selectable but never implied. testMatch overrides the folder glob. scope decides where a family runs: game = every selected game, package = the first selected game of each package, environment = once per run (first lane only). requires is the baseline every case in the family needs; the shared fixture turns an unsupported baseline into N/A and an undeclared one into NOT CONFIGURED before the game opens. Case-specific features stay on the spec via requireCapabilities.

regression.label: Regression
regression.description: docs/RegressionTestCases.md families. 'All Regression' selects exactly these.

security.label: Security / Pentesting
security.description: Security checks against staging with test accounts only. Never part of a regression selection; select PEN explicitly.

other.label: Other automated families
other.description: Scratch game, menu, wilds and the reel data contract. Selectable on their own; not implied by 'All Regression'.

suiteNotes: Presets on the QA page. families accepts family ids and @group tokens (@regression never includes PEN); testMatch is for presets that pick individual cases.

suites.label: All Regression (no PEN)
suites.description: Every regression family on each selected game. Pentesting is not included.

suites.label: Security / Pentesting (PEN only)
suites.description: Every PEN case once per run, on the first selected game. Staging test accounts only.

suites.label: Full automated regression + scratch, menu, wilds, reel data (no PEN)
suites.description: Every regression family plus the other automated families. Pentesting is not included; select PEN on its own.

suites.label: Scratch Game (SCG) — all cases
suites.description: Every SCG scratch-card case on each game of the selected packages.

suites.label: Regression — CSF-011, AT-002–005, ES-007–008
suites.description: The regression cases automated last (currency, refund, multiple sessions, max win cap and message, normal-mode multiplier).
